title: Kamailio World 2026: Dates And Location
html:
A short announcement to inform that the dates for next Kamailio World Conference have been set to May 7-8, 2026, the event to take place again in Berlin, Germany. It will be at the same venue like the 2025 edition.

The event website and more details will be published soon at:

  • https://www.kamailioworld.com

Thanks for flying Kamailio!
